description: This Java class defines the Customer entity for the sales management system, including fields for customer details, relationships to reviews, groups, merchant store, and embedded billing/delivery info.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Entity class representing a customer with personal details, preferences, and relationships to reviews, groups, and store.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the customer's unique identifier.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the customer's unique identifier.

methods.name: getDateOfBirth
methods.description: Returns a clone of the customer's date of birth.

methods.name: setDateOfBirth
methods.description: Sets the customer's date of birth.

methods.name: getEmailAddress
methods.description: Returns the customer's email address.

methods.name: setEmailAddress
methods.description: Sets the customer's email address.

methods.name: getNick
methods.description: Returns the customer's nickname.

methods.name: setNick
methods.description: Sets the customer's nickname.

methods.name: getCompany
methods.description: Returns the customer's company.

methods.name: setCompany
methods.description: Sets the customer's company.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the customer's password.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the customer's password.

methods.name: isAnonymous
methods.description: Checks if the customer is anonymous.

methods.name: setAnonymous
methods.description: Sets the customer's anonymous status.

methods.name: getReviews
methods.description: Returns the list of product reviews associated with the customer.

methods.name: setReviews
methods.description: Sets the list of product reviews.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with the customer.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with the customer.

methods.name: setDelivery
methods.description: Sets the delivery information for the customer.

methods.name: getDelivery
methods.description: Returns the delivery information.

methods.name: setBilling
methods.description: Sets the billing information for the customer.

methods.name: getBilling
methods.description: Returns the billing information.

methods.name: setGroups
methods.description: Assigns groups to the customer.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns the list of groups the customer belongs to.

methods.name: getShowCustomerStateList
methods.description: Returns the customer state list display string.

methods.name: setShowCustomerStateList
methods.description: Sets the customer state list display string.

methods.name: getShowBillingStateList
methods.description: Returns the billing state list display string.

methods.name: setShowBillingStateList
methods.description: Sets the billing state list display string.

methods.name: getShowDeliveryStateList
methods.description: Returns the delivery state list display string.

methods.name: setShowDeliveryStateList
methods.description: Sets the delivery state list display string.

methods.name: getDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Returns the default language of the customer.

methods.name: setDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Sets the default language for the customer.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the customer attributes.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the customer attributes.

methods.name: setGender
methods.description: Sets the customer's gender.

methods.name: getGender
methods.description: Returns the customer's gender.
